in_sanskrit.name: अमेयात्मज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is born of the imperishable soul

in_hindi.name: अमेयात्मज
in_hindi.long_meaning: Aprahat - One who is not killed, or one who is imperishable

in_tamil.name: அமெயாத்மஜ
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ameyavum irundha avarkal jayambikaiyal - One who brings victory to those who have the imperishable soul

in_telugu.name: అమేయాట్మజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ameyapputa atyadheshvarayeyalu - One who is the lord of the imperishable

in_marathi.name: Ameyatmaja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ameyatmaja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ameyatmaja is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ameya’ meaning immortal and ‘atma’ meaning soul. This name signifies one whose soul is immortal and indestructible. It is a powerful name that evokes a sense of spiritual depth and inner strength.
